**Image 1 (Contact Page - Desktop): PASS**
The layout is clean, well-aligned with consistent padding and professional typography suitable for a premium corporate brand.

**Image 2 (Service Division Page - Mobile): FAIL**
The accessibility widget icon in the bottom-left corner is overlapping the body text ("follow-through"), creating a cluttered and unprofessional appearance.

**Image 3 (Home Page - Mobile): FAIL**
The large decorative graphic at the bottom of the screen is cut off by the edge of the viewport, making the layout look unfinished.
